changes: Month normalized: śrādhavaṇa read as Śrāvaṇa (corrupt spelling)
Weekday given as Sunday (ravau); tithi 15 of the śukla fortnight noted as pūrṇimā
Notes expanded: year 161 with 'ekottara' looks like a digit has dropped out (e.g. VS 1661), so era and CE are left undetermined
Person record kept as it was (Śivāditya, author, miśra as a title)

notes: The author is Śivāditya (Śivādityamiśra); the colophon has the corrupt form śivādibhya(!)miśra. The year is given as 'saṃvat 161', and 'ekottarāvārṣe' (!) only spells out the 'one-over' part. A digit has probably been lost. Since the script is Devanagari, the date could be VS 1661, which would be about 1604 CE, but this is a guess, so era and CE are left blank. NS 161 (1041 CE) is very unlikely for a Devanagari copy of this text. Month 'śrādhavaṇa' is a corrupt spelling of Śrāvaṇa. No scribe, owner or place is named.
